name: Tsideh
tagline: Pop-up kitchen in Northern New Mexico
heroHeadline: A pop-up kitchen of the Northern Rio Grande.
description: Pre-order pickup from Tsideh, a pop-up kitchen by Chef Rainbird Taylor, Ohkay Owingeh, or request catering for your gathering.

catering.blurb: From a five-course plated tasting with the chef to boxed lunches for your team, we bring the kitchen to you. Tell us about your event and we'll reply with a menu and a quote. Most of our menu is naturally gluten-free and plant-forward. Tell us about allergies or dietary needs — there's never an extra charge.
serviceStyles: Chef's Table — five-course plated tasting with the chef, parties up to 30 (book 3 weeks ahead)
Family Table — family-style or elevated buffet, 25 guests or more (book 2 weeks ahead)
Harvest Drop-Off — delivered and styled, no staff, 25 guests or more (72 hours ahead)
Boxed lunches — 10 boxes or more (order by noon, two business days ahead)
